problem: day-ahead aggregate EV flexibility forecasting and dispatch
core_method: dynamic power/energy domain with energy jump; MTL-CNN-GRU, QR-CNN-GRU and daily-sum CNN
prediction_output: four power/energy boundaries, probabilistic energy jump and daily energy
data_and_protocol: Caltech campus garage, 55 charging stations/EVSEs; no strict station/city OOD reported
verified_result: R2 0.914; 5.0% cost reduction vs uncontrolled, 12.7% vs empirical; 90.7% of oracle value
novelty_already_occupied: direct boundary forecasting + physical coupling + jump uncertainty + dispatch
remaining_gap_after_audit: strict OOD/generalization, calibrated decision risk, multi-domain validation and safe abstention remain open

problem: forecasting unknown departure/session duration for controlled EV charging
core_method: session-duration forecaster jointly trained with a Soft Actor-Critic controller through regression and decision-focused losses
prediction_output: point estimate of total/remaining session duration used in the RL state
data_and_protocol: hospital public-parking sessions; 20 frequent users; statistical generation of 350 training and 120 test sessions; 30-min resolution; fixed 6.5 kW
downstream_evaluation: rolling single-EV controlled charging under one deterministic price profile
verified_result: up to 14% reward improvement and 55% lower unsupplied energy versus RL without a forecaster; versus a conventional forecaster, the reported best decision-focused setting improves reward by about 5% and reduces unmet energy by about 14%
novelty_already_occupied: end-to-end decision feedback from EV charging control to a departure/session-duration forecaster
remaining_gap_after_audit: aggregate multi-EV hard constraints, probabilistic/set forecasts, stochastic or robust MPC, strict OOD and large real-world evaluation remain open

problem: confidence-resolved disclosure of EV-aggregator flexibility under uncertainty
core_method: probability-guaranteed feasible region; inverse-function chance-constraint reformulation; McCormick relaxation; outer progressive approximation
data_and_protocol: modified IEEE 33-bus and 141-bus Venezuelan distribution networks; model-based stochastic cases
downstream_evaluation: EVA–grid coordination and balancing-service capability representation
verified_result: publisher page reports that the constraint scale and total computational load are reduced to 7.9% of the original model; case studies use modified 33-node and 141-node distribution systems, while no real charging-forecast benchmark is reported
novelty_already_occupied: a probability/confidence-guaranteed aggregate EV feasible-region representation for grid coordination
remaining_gap_after_audit: data-driven forecast construction, finite-sample/OOD calibration, real charging data and forecast-to-dispatch risk propagation remain open

problem: online probabilistic forecasting under evolving charging patterns
core_method: long-term anchor + rolling load descriptors + frozen-LM semantic prompts + drift-aware adapter/gate + delayed feedback
data_and_protocol: 10 MP-EVData stations; first 60 days initialization, then online 1-h/4-h forecasts
verified_result: best-baseline MSE/pinball reductions 15.3%/17.8% at 1 h and 16.8%/22.6% at 4 h
remaining_gap_after_audit: actual session-behavior mechanisms, strict held-out domains, dispatch risk and peer review remain open
